title: Justice & Injustice
subtitle: Fairness at the Playground
keyMessage: Share, take turns, and make room for everyone.

scenes.heading: A fair day at the playground
scenes.narration: Welcome to the playground! Today Ruhi, Aima, and Nuh are learning what fairness feels like.

scenes.heading: Is this fair?
scenes.narration: A tray has six sweet treats. Nuh takes all six for himself, leaving none for Ruhi and Aima.

scenes.heading: Everyone gets a share
scenes.narration: Ruhi pauses the game and shares them fairly. Now Ruhi, Aima, and Nuh each get two treats!

scenes.heading: Wait, then take a turn
scenes.narration: Next, the children want the slide. Ruhi, Aima, and Nuh line up patiently and take turns.

scenes.heading: Make room in the game
scenes.narration: Aima sits alone on the bench. Ruhi and Nuh smile and ask, Would you like to play with us?

scenes.heading: Fairness helps us belong
scenes.narration: Fairness means sharing, taking turns, and making sure nobody is left out of the fun.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: Your turn to think! If you see a friend left out of a game, what is one fair thing you can do?

title: Wealth & Poverty
subtitle: More Than Money
keyMessage: Money does not decide how much a person matters.

scenes.heading: A game at the market
scenes.narration: At the school market, Nuh and Aima bring their play tokens to choose a game together.

scenes.heading: Different amounts
scenes.narration: Nuh has many tokens, and Aima has just two. In real life, families have different amounts of money.

scenes.heading: People are more than money
scenes.narration: Having more tokens does not make Nuh better. Having fewer does not make Aima less important.

scenes.heading: Choose a game together
scenes.narration: They find a game they can both play. Nuh shares his chalk, and Aima draws the first hopscotch square.

scenes.heading: Friendship is not measured in coins
scenes.narration: Ruhi joins in, and they laugh and play together. True friendship is never measured in coins.

scenes.heading: Be kind and respectful
scenes.narration: We treat everyone with kindness and respect, no matter how much money someone has. We never tease.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: Your turn to think! A friend has fewer coins or toys. What kind game could you invite them to play?

title: Equality of Opportunity
subtitle: Everyone Gets a Chance
keyMessage: Everyone deserves a chance to join, choose, and try.

scenes.heading: Different favourites
scenes.narration: In the sunny garden, Ruhi, Aima, and Nuh enjoy different healthy foods and games.

scenes.heading: Our choices can be different
scenes.narration: Ruhi loves fresh cucumbers, and Aima chooses sweet mango. Both choices are wonderful for them.

scenes.heading: Everyone gets to choose
scenes.narration: At playtime, everyone gets a fair chance to choose an activity and try it.

scenes.heading: More ways to join
scenes.narration: They set out a soft ball, a colorful hoop, and picture cards so there are choices for everyone.

scenes.heading: Make space for a friend
scenes.narration: Aima needs a little more time to join. Ruhi and Nuh make space and warmly offer a turn.

scenes.heading: A chance for everyone
scenes.narration: Fair opportunity means everyone has a chance to take part, even when we like different things.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: Your turn to think! What is one way you can help every friend get a fair chance to join a game?

title: Challenging Injustice
subtitle: Make Things Right
keyMessage: Tell the truth, say sorry, and help repair the harm.

scenes.heading: A moment at art time
scenes.narration: During art time, Nuh accidentally bumps a tall block tower, and it tumbles down.

scenes.heading: Mistakes can happen
scenes.narration: Nuh feels worried. He could walk away, but he chooses to be brave and tell the truth.

scenes.heading: Tell the truth and say sorry
scenes.narration: I bumped it by mistake. I am really sorry, Nuh tells Ruhi and Aima.

scenes.heading: Listen and work together
scenes.narration: Ruhi and Aima listen kindly. Together, they gather the blocks and start building again.

scenes.heading: Help make it right
scenes.narration: Nuh helps rebuild the tower, then checks that everyone is ready to play together.

scenes.heading: Speak kindly when something is unfair
scenes.narration: When a mistake happens, we can speak kindly, tell the truth, and help make things right.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: Your turn to think! What is one brave thing you can say or do after making a mistake?
